name: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke

categories.label: Won
categories.hint: Tick for the side (Witch or Hunter) whose win condition was met; no points.

winCondition: Witch: Ritual on her true-identity villager with 3 Favor, or three villagers eliminated without hitting her identity. Hunter: eliminate the Witch's identity villager, or draw all 8 suspect cards with Exonerate (3 Evidence per card). Ends at once; no points.
notes: family: deduction (asymmetric 1v1, no score). Verified against the official turn-flow reference sheet (2 pages) for ritual with 3 favors, elimination check, 'three villagers eliminated' and 'drawn all 8 suspect cards' branches. Eliminating a villager needs at least 3 Clue tokens (BGA help); not shown on the reference sheet. No tiebreak or draw exists. Full multi-page rulebook text not read, only the reference sheet.

roles.label: Witch
roles.winCondition: Perform the Ritual while the villager that is her true identity has 3 Favor tokens, or 3 villagers eliminated without the Witch's identity among them.

roles.label: Hunter
roles.winCondition: Eliminate the villager that is the Witch's true identity, or draw all 8 suspect cards via Exonerate.

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when either side meets a win condition.
